annotations.title: But not iuſtified.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> The Heretikes are certaine that they be in Gods grace, but S. Paul though guiltie of no crime in his conſcience, durſt not aſſure him ſelf that he vvas iuſtified, neither could take vpon him to be iudge of his ovvne hart and cogitations, vvhether they vvere pure or no: but the trial thereof he left onely to Gods iudging day.

notes.text: No man sure of grace or iustification.

annotations.title: In rodde.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> The Apoſtles haue power of diſcipline and cenſures againſt offenders, and power of gentlenes, meekenes, and indulgence alſo: to vſe either puniſhing or pardoning, according to their wiſedom, and according to the occaſions of time and place.

notes.text: Spiritual power to punish or pardon.
